descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-17 Post-Round Review & Completion · S18 Existing specs on ready-for-qa tickets: a failed generation keeps the dictation with a retry message; a failed billing suggestion retries on tap; Ask opens from every Nursing Home tab

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T8a Note generation failed, Encounter side (TFA-94745 state 4): the typed dictation is kept, also after a reload, and an explicit message says the note was not generated and what to do next (retry), in H … (TFA-94745 state 4; TFA-94745 AC 3; TFA-94745 AC 5; TFA-94745 AC 6; UAT Empty & Failure States)
  • T9 Billing suggestion failed (TFA-94745 state 5): the billing area on the Post-Round Note tab shows an error that says what to do next, and one tap retries. … (TFA-94745 state 5; TFA-94745 AC 5; UAT Empty & Failure States)
  • T10 Ask from Post-Round (TFA-92593): 'Ask About the Encounter or Patient' opens from Post-Round in both contexts, and its answers use only this patient's stored data: the saved note as last edited, nothi … (TFA-92593 AC 2; TFA-92593 AC 3; TFA-92593 AC 6; TFA-92593 AC 9; UAT 3.4; UAT TC-17)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Tim's fixtures: a Hospital patient whose first ai/notes:generateNote call is made to fail at the Convex socket; a Hospital patient in note-ready whose first suggestBilling call fails; a Nursing Home resident in today's session

When Type a dictation on Encounter and tap Generate Note & Finish; open Post-Round on the billing fixture (the Note toggle is the default) and tap the error line; open Ask from each Nursing Home tab including Post-Round

Then The Encounter tab says the dictation is saved but the note could not be generated and to tap Generate Note & Finish to retry, and the dictation is still on screen and stored; 'Couldn't generate billing suggestion — tap to retry' shows and one tap shows the code; 'Ask About This Patient' opens from the Nursing Home Post-Round tab with a post-round preset

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions. Every req is ungated (TFA-94745, TFA-92593: ready for qa), so a failure reports as Fail. Hospital only for T8a and T9; Nursing Home only for T10's entry point. Not asserted here: 'Note not generated' on the Post-Round Note tab and the Nursing Home dictation (S19); the automatic retry before the error (the socket mock skips the server retries; …

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S18 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-17.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).

This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
